status: source-only compatibility screen for a nominal hard probe; not calibrated measurement correction
rules: Verify all source-file hashes and reject holdout numerical loads.
The necessary axial support condition for constant-velocity transit through a hard volume is abs(u_axial)*TT <= L_axial. It does not require the missing third velocity.
A generous finite-sphere overlap condition expands the support by D. This is not the actual optical response or proof of a valid correction.
The velocity allowance is 1 percent of the largest stated 192 m/s span; it is an intentionally generous scenario, not an event-specific uncertainty calibration.
Do not infer an uncertainty for TT, a size-dependent detection volume, validation efficiency or processor dead time from the nominal dimensions.
Retain every event, flag all incompatible scenarios, and report station and size-bin counts without deleting records or refitting the geometry.
Passing a necessary support condition does not qualify a probe model; incompatibility does not establish corrupt raw data.
Do not change source/holdout roles or physical acceptance criteria.
